name: EX-14 Logistics & Sustainment — 5 Days
description: 5-day logistics and sustainment exercise for a brigade-sized force conducting prolonged operations. Focuses on supply chain management, fuel and ammunition resupply, maintenance operations, medical evacuation, and field logistics coordination under simulated operational conditions. Working-hours schedule (0700–1900). Suitable for logistics battalion and sustainment brigade staff exercises.

items.title: INITEX — Logistics Base Established
items.description: Exercise commenced. Main Supply Route (MSR) identified and patrolled. Forward Logistics Base (FLB) established at grid 6432. Supply company begins reception, staging, and onward movement of Day 1 supplies. Maintenance collection point established.

items.title: Morning Log Meeting — Day 1
items.description: Daily logistics synchronisation meeting. Agenda: supply status (POL, ammo, rations, water), vehicle maintenance status, medical readiness, MSR security update, 48-hour requirements forecast.

items.title: Fuel Resupply — Forward Units
items.description: Supply Company conducts bulk fuel resupply to forward units. 2x HEMTT tankers dispatched on MSR Echo. Total: 14,000 litres. Consumption tracking updated. Warning order issued for Day 2 resupply based on forecasted usage.

items.title: INJECT: Vehicle Breakdown — MSR Obstruction
items.description: EXERCISE INJECT: Logistics vehicle (5-tonne truck) breaks down on MSR Echo — blocks single-lane section. Recovery vehicle tasked. Alternate routing coordinated. MSR traffic management activated. Estimated 2-hour recovery time. Supply schedule adjusted.

items.title: Ammunition Resupply — Class V
items.description: Controlled ammunition resupply to forward units. Ammunition Holding Area procedures followed. Issue documentation completed. Unexploded ordnance (UXO) report from forward unit processed — EOD team tasked. Ammo tracking spreadsheet updated in BMS.

items.title: INJECT: MEDEVAC Request
items.description: EXERCISE INJECT: 9-liner MEDEVAC request received for 2 exercise casualties (simulated). Medical platoon dispatches ambulance. MEDEVAC helicopter tasked. Role 2 facility notified. Casualties triaged and transported within MEDEVAC time standard.

items.title: Surge: 24h Continuous Operations
items.description: Operational tempo increases — surge logistics required. Supply company operates 24/7. Fuel consumption doubles. Ration pack resupply accelerated. Maintenance 2-hour response SLA implemented. All logistics sections on 12-hour shifts.

items.title: ENDEX
items.description: ENDEX declared. All forward logistics operations stood down. Equipment and vehicles returned to FLB. Final supply and maintenance status report submitted to G4.

items.title: Logistics AAR
items.description: Logistics AAR. Metrics reviewed: supply delivery on-time percentage, vehicle availability rates, MEDEVAC response times, fuel consumption accuracy vs forecast. Lessons identified: MSR vulnerability, 24h operations staffing gaps, Class V accounting procedures.
